stories.title: Flintshire school transport operators ask council for more money over fuel costs
stories.summary: School transport operators have asked Flintshire County Council for higher contract payments because of fuel costs, and no extra money has been agreed. stories.title: Mold archive plan for Flintshire and Denbighshire set for approval
stories.summary: Plans for a new joint archive serving Flintshire and Denbighshire are set to be approved next week. Flintshire County Council has applied to its own planning committee for a purpose-built building on land next to Theatr Clwyd, off Raikes Lane in Mold, to house the archive services and collections of both councils. stories.title: One charge for every 82 spiking reports to North Wales Police

stories.title: £200m carbon capture facility at Parc Adfer recommended for approval
stories.summary: A £200 million carbon capture facility which will collect almost a quarter of a million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year is seeking approval by Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Flintshire and Wrexham schools could face headteacher strike action after NAHT Cymru ballot
stories.summary: Schools across Flintshire and Wrexham could face industrial action from headteachers over funding for additional learning needs (ALN) and pay. Members of the National Association of Headteachers (NAHT) Cymru have voted overwhelmingly in favour of strike action if Welsh Government fails to improve wage conditions and pump more money into ALN support.
